question: Among customers who made transactions at Czech Republic gas stations in 2012, which customer experienced the highest percentage decrease in consumption from 2012 to 2013?

    SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    WHERE g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
      AND t.XCL_011 >= '2012-01-01'
      AND t.XCL_011 < '2013-01-01'
),
consumption AS (
    SELECT
        ym.XCL_019 AS customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    WHERE ym.XCL_019 IN (SELECT customer_id FROM eligible_customers)
    GROUP BY ym.XCL_019
)
SELECT c.XCL_001
FROM customers AS c
INNER JOIN consumption AS cons ON c.XCL_001 = cons.customer_id
WHERE cons.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM eligible_customers)
  AND cons.consumption_2012 > 0
  AND cons.consumption_2013 < cons.consumption_2012
ORDER BY (cons.consumption_2012 - cons.consumption_2013) * 100.0 / cons.consumption_2012 DESC
LIMIT 1
